# Lab fixtures

The input is an authored example of the task builder's lab and vital-sign row formats. It contains no patient data.
The fixture is covered by this repository's license.

The two mg/dL creatinine values have count 2, minimum 1.0, maximum 1.4, mean 1.2, and latest value 1.4.
The 110 umol/L value forms a separate group. The vital-sign row is excluded with a note.
These hand-derived results provide the independent baseline. Clinical-data verification requires authorized task samples.
